scientific_integrity.evidence: Self-contained algebraic proof with standalone exact-rational finite checks

scientific_limitations: Exactly one vacant vertex, unweighted complete bipartite graph with both parts at least two, discrete agent types, fraction of occupied unlike neighbors, and strict unilateral jumps. Theorems concern exact potential and maximum number of improving moves only, not stochastic convergence, arbitrary bipartite graphs, multiple vacancies or optimal convergence complexity.
title: An exact potential and a cubic improvement bound for diversity-seeking jumps on complete bipartite graphs
